jobs.title: Digital Innovation Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

Where strategy meets momentum

DuPont’s Digital Innovation team builds AI, automation, and analytics capabilities that help a global science company work faster, smarter, and with greater impact. The team manages a growing portfolio of priorities across the business and needs a strong leader who can turn strategy into disciplined execution.
As the Digital Innovation Operations Manager, you will create the structure, cadence, and visibility needed to keep critical initiatives moving. You will track progress, connect dependencies, surface risks early, and ensure leaders have the information they need to make decisions. Just as important, you will make sure those decisions translate into clear owners, next steps, and completed work.

The ideal candidate brings strong AI and digital fluency, sound judgment, and a builder mindset. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, creating order where none exists, and improving how teams plan, track, communicate, and deliver. This is a role for someone who can see the whole board, spot what might slow progress, and build practical ways of working that scale.

How You’ll Create Impact

Keep strategic initiatives moving
You own the operating rhythm of the Digital Innovation portfolio: planning cycles, governance forums, leadership reviews, and the follow-through that happens between them. You track progress across AI, analytics, automation, and digital enablement initiatives, map the dependencies that connect them, and drive the conversations that unblock delivery. Risks, resource constraints, and cross-functional snags get named early and escalated with a recommendation attached, not just a flag.

Turn information into decisions
Leaders across IT and the businesses depend on a clear, current picture of where the portfolio stands. You gather that picture from program teams, vendors, and Center of Excellence partners, then shape it into executive updates, dashboards, and briefing materials that are short, honest, and decision ready. You frame the choice, lay out the trade-offs, capture what was decided, and close the loop on actions.

Build the ways of working
You help people successfully adopt the capabilities we deliver. From AI enablement and training programs to communications, stakeholder engagement, and change management, you ensure new ways of working become lasting habits. You champion responsible AI practices and help teams realize measurable value from the technologies we introduce.

Build the operating system for delivery
Jira is becoming the backbone of how Digital Innovation plans and tracks work, and this role owns that transition. You will define the project and workflow design, configure boards, backlogs, and reporting to match how the team delivers, and partner with platform support teams on administration and integrations. Just as importantly, you will drive adoption: onboarding teams, running training, writing the documentation people reach for, and steadily raising data quality until Jira is the single trusted source of portfolio status.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Three months
You know every active initiative, its owner, its timeline, and its risks, and the leadership update cadence is running on a predictable schedule. Jira is properly configured and fully deployed across the team's core programs with agreed workflows and fields, and every team is onboarded and trained.

Six months
Portfolio status is pulled from Jira rather than assembled by hand, and leadership reviews start from live data.

Twelve months
Decisions, actions, and dependencies live in one place, and the operating rhythm holds.

What You Bring
We care more about how you think and operate than about a specific title on your resume. The people who thrive here tend to bring:
- Program management depth: planning, prioritization, risk management, decision tracking, and relentless follow-through.

- Experience delivering initiatives at the enterprise scale involving AI, automation, and analytics.

- Curiosity and a learner mindset that keeps pace with emerging technologies.

- Adoption and change management , including knowledge of the ADKAR model.

- Hands-on Jira experience , including project and workflow configuration, backlog and board design, and reporting; Confluence and other work management tools are a plus.

- Executive communication skills : the judgment to know what a leader needs to see, and the discipline to say it in one page.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Collaboration tools including M365, Sharepoint, PowerBI, Teams, etc…

- Data storytelling: the ability to compile information from multiple sources and shape it into a clear, compelling story that helps leaders understand progress, value, and next steps.

- A talent for creating structure in ambiguous environments and keeping teams aligned on priorities, owners, and next steps.

- Strong influential leadership skills and the ability to build trust quickly with business partners, functional leaders, and technical teams.

- High ownership, sharp attention to detail , sound judgment, and comfort managing competing priorities.

Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

- 10+ years in technical project management, program management, business operations, or a closely related role.

- 5+ years supporting digital, AI, automation, analytics, or enterprise technology initiatives.

- Demonstrated experience deploying or administering a work management platform such as Jira, including driving adoption across teams.

- Experience working with cross-functional teams in a complex, global enterprise environment.

Why You'll Want This Role
You will work alongside data scientists, analytics leaders, designers, and business partners on emerging technology that is genuinely new to the company, and you will help decide how DuPont adopts it responsibly.
This is also a builder's role. The processes, the reporting, the Jira environment, the operating rhythm - you will shape all of it, and the way this team works a year from now will look the way you designed it. If you want scope, proximity to decision-making, and a portfolio of work that matters, this is the seat.

jobs.description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. We are seeking a Plant Continuous Improvement Leader at Valley View, Ohio site.  This role will work with a diverse team to support the manufacturing of Vespel® Polyimide Resins.
The Plant Continuous Improvement (CI) Leader improves plant performance by deploying and sustaining the DuPont Operational Excellence System. The role partners with plant leadership, front-line teams, and Business OpEx resources to improve SQDIP results through Daily Management, structured problem solving, Kaizen, value stream improvement, and capability building.
The CI Leader serves as the local OpEx practitioner and change leader, coaching employees and leaders, facilitating improvement work (including sustainment activities), and connecting site priorities to the broader CI network and digital / Industry 4.0 opportunities.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Operational Excellence Deployment
- Partner with plant leadership to identify performance gaps and priorities linked to SQDIP, margin, EBITDA, and operational maturity.
- Build and execute the plant OpEx roadmap aligned with site and business objectives.
- Deploy and sustain the DuPont OpEx framework and business system using defined playbooks, roles, and routines.

Daily Management & Performance Systems
- Coach leaders and teams on Daily Visual Management, Bowler / tiered accountability, Leader Standard Work, action tracking, and escalation.
- Use performance data to identify losses, bottlenecks, waste, and execution gaps.

Continuous Improvement & Kaizen
- Lead Kaizen events, focused improvement workshops, value stream improvement, and waste elimination activities. Collaborating with cross-functional teams build/maintain/prioritize Kaizen funnel and sustainment processes.
- Coach projects from problem definition through implementation, sustainment, and financial validation using Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and data-based problem solving.

Program Management & Benefits Validation
- Lead or support the plant Project Management Office (PMO), including opportunity pipeline, decision cadence, milestone tracking, and benefit validation.
- Partner across functions / plants to define charters, benefits, scope, resources, timelines, and project plans.

Capability Building & Best Practice Sharing
- Build site capability through coaching, workshops, OpEx Academy learning, and hands-on application of tools such as 5S, SMED, VSM, Kaizen, and problem solving.
- Share lessons learned and leverage the CI network to accelerate adoption of proven practices.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Business, Information Technologies, or related field.
- Clear verbal and written communication that connects people to purpose.
- Relevant experience in manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, operations, or Operational Excellence experience.
- Lean Practitioner / Continuous Improvement certification preferred.
- Green Belt certification preferred.
- Ability to coach, teach, mentor, and facilitate practical learning
- Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Daily Management, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, SMED, and structured problem solving.
- Manufacturing site leadership.
- Experience with project benefits tracking, and digital / Industry 4.0 improvement approaches.
- Availability for travel up to 20% of the time.

jobs.description:

Der Site Continuous Improvement (CI) Leader am Standort Schkopau verbessert die Leistungsfähigkeit des Werks durch die Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und nachhaltige Verankerung des DuPont Operational Excellence Systems . In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie eng mit der Werkleitung, den operativen Teams sowie den Business-OpEx-Ressourcen zusammen, um die Ergebnisse in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Qualität, Lieferung, Bestand und Produktivität (SQDIP) durch Daily Management, strukturierte Problemlösung, Kaizen, Wertstromverbesserungen und den Aufbau von Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Der CI Leader fungiert als lokaler Operational-Excellence-Experte und als treibende Kraft für Veränderungen . Er unterstützt und coacht Mitarbeitende sowie Führungskräfte, moderiert Verbesserungsinitiativen einschließlich der nachhaltigen Sicherstellung erzielter Ergebnisse und verbindet die Prioritäten des Standorts mit dem globalen CI-Netzwerk sowie den Möglichkeiten der Digitalisierung und Industrie 4.0.

Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

Operational Excellence Deployment
- Zusammenarbeit mit der Werkleitung zur Identifizierung von Leistungsdefiziten und Prioritäten im Zusammenhang mit SQDIP, Marge, EBITDA und operativem Reifegrad.

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Operational-Excellence-Roadmap des Standorts in Übereinstimmung mit den Zielen des Werks und des Geschäftsbereichs.

- Einführung, Implementierung und nachhaltige Verankerung des DuPont Operational Excellence Frameworks und des entsprechenden Business Systems unter Anwendung definierter Standards, Rollen und Routinen.

Daily Management & Performance-Systeme
- Coaching von Führungskräften und Teams in den Bereichen Daily Visual Management, Bowler- beziehungsweise Tier-Management-Systeme, Leader Standard Work, Maßnahmenverfolgung und Eskalationsprozesse.

- Nutzung von Leistungskennzahlen und Datenanalysen zur Identifikation von Verlusten, Engpässen, Verschwendung und Umsetzungsdefiziten.

Kontinuierliche Verbesserung & Kaizen
- Leitung von Kaizen-Workshops, fokussierten Verbesserungsinitiativen, Wertstromverbesserungen und Aktivitäten zur Verschwendungsreduzierung. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams Aufbau, Pflege und Priorisierung der Kaizen-Pipeline sowie Sicherstellung nachhaltiger Umsetzungsprozesse.

- Coaching von Projekten von der Problemdefinition über die Implementierung bis hin zur nachhaltigen Verankerung und finanziellen Nutzenvalidierung unter Anwendung von Lean-, Six-Sigma-, Agile- und datenbasierten Problemlösungsmethoden.

Programmmanagement & Nutzenvalidierung
- Leitung oder Unterstützung des standortbezogenen Project Management Office (PMO), einschließlich Chancen- und Projektpipeline, Entscheidungsroutinen, Meilensteinverfolgung sowie Nutzenvalidierung.

- Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen und Standorte hinweg zur Definition von Projektaufträgen, Nutzenpotenzialen, Projektumfang, Ressourcenbedarf, Zeitplänen und Projektplänen.

Kompetenzaufbau & Austausch bewährter Praktiken
- Aufbau von Standortkompetenzen durch Coaching, Workshops, Lernprogramme der OpEx Academy sowie die praktische Anwendung von Methoden und Werkzeugen wie 5S, SMED, Wertstromanalyse (VSM), Kaizen und strukturierter Problemlösung.

- Austausch von Erfahrungen und Best Practices sowie Nutzung des Continuous-Improvement-Netzwerks zur beschleunigten Einführung bewährter Methoden und Lösungen.

Anforderungen
- Fundierte Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Produktion, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations oder Operational Excellence.

- Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Lean-, Six-Sigma-, Agile- oder Continuous-Improvement-Methoden in einem Produktionsumfeld.

- Erfahrung in der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Verbesserungsinitiativen, Kaizen-Workshops und strukturierter Problemlösungsprozesse.

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Operational-Excellence-Roadmaps, Projektaufträgen, Implementierungsplänen und Ansätzen zur Nutzenvalidierung.

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Produktion, Betriebswirtschaft, Informationstechnologie oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

- Lean-Practitioner- oder Continuous-Improvement-Zertifizierung von Vorteil.

- Green-Belt-Zertifizierung wünschenswert oder entsprechend der Anforderungen des Standorts bzw. Geschäftsbereichs erforderlich.

- Erfahrung im Coaching von Führungskräften und Teams zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung von Kompetenzen und Sicherstellung langfristiger Ergebnisse.

- Erfahrung in disziplinarischer Führung, informeller Führung oder Mitarbeiterführung von Vorteil.

- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und Einflussnahme über verschiedene Hierarchieebenen und Funktionen hinweg.

- Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte zu coachen, zu schulen, zu begleiten und praxisorientiertes Lernen zu fördern.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lean Management, Six Sigma, Agile, Daily Management, Kaizen, Wertstromanalyse, SMED sowie strukturierter Problemlösung.

- Analytisches Denkvermögen, technisches Verständnis und ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz.

- Fähigkeit, Vertrauen aufzubauen und Veränderungen auch ohne direkte disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis erfolgreich voranzutreiben.

- Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele begeistern und verbinden.

Overview
Tyvek® Roll Goods is looking for a Commercial Excellence & Marketing Operations Lead to translate marketing strategy into disciplined go-to-market execution and measurable business impact.

Reporting to the Commercial Excellence Leader, this role connects Marketing, Sales, Product Management, and Commercial Excellence to strengthen demand generation, lead management, competitive intelligence, and commercial program deployment across regions.

This is an individual contributor leadership role: the successful candidate will lead through influence, governance, and cross-functional collaboration rather than direct people management.

Growth opportunity: Shape scalable commercial operating practices that improve pipeline generation, increase commercial effectiveness, and make market insights easier to act on globally.

Location: Wilmington, DE preferred; Hybrid schedule with an expectation of 4 days onsite and 1 day remote per week.
Remote work may be considered for qualified candidates.

Travel: ~10%

Key Responsibilities
1. Go-to-Market Activation & Program Management
- Translate strategic priorities into sales plays and scalable growth programs.

- Lead program execution across regions, ensuring clear governance, accountability, and performance tracking.

- Define objectives, timelines, success metrics, and stakeholder alignment.

- Drive continuous optimization to maximize business impact.

2. Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights
- Establish and manage a competitive intelligence and market insights framework for Tyvek® Roll Goods.

- Analyze market trends, competitor activity, customer needs, and growth opportunities.

- Translate insights into actionable recommendations and strategic decisions.

3. Continuous Improvement & Best Practice Deployment
- Improve marketing effectiveness through standardized processes, governance, and best practices.

- Promote knowledge sharing and scalable ways of working across regions.

What Success Looks Like
- Successful global deployment of Sales Plays with strong adoption and measurable business results.

- Improved commercial effectiveness through scalable processes and disciplined execution.

- Enhanced market and competitive insights that support better decision-making.

Essential Leadership Behaviors
- Ownership and accountability for results.

- Influences and collaborates effectively across a matrix organization.

- Builds trust and alignment across functions and regions.

- Makes data-driven, customer-focused decisions.

- Continuously improves, simplifies, and scales processes.

- Demonstrates a growth mindset and promotes learning.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as marketing or business

- Strong project management, stakeholder management, communication, organizational, and analytical capabilities. Ability to influence and drive alignment without direct authority.

- Umfangreiche einschlägige Berufserfahrung nach dem Studium in der Entwicklung von Geräten und Maschinen sowie in der Fertigung.

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Robotik‑ und hochautomatisierten Systemen, einschließlich Close‑Loop‑Prozessregelungen.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit externen OEM‑Partnern sowie Auftrags‑ und Vertragsfertigern.
